description: Assay provenance behind a bioactivity row: description, type (binding / functional / ADMET / toxicity), the target it measures, organism, and ChEMBL's 1–9 confidence score (9 = direct assay on the protein target, lower = homologous or indirect). Supply assay_chembl_id from a chembl_get_bioactivities row. Call this to judge whether two measurements are comparable before ranking them together.

assay_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL assay ID from a bioactivity row's assay_chembl_id, e.g. "CHEMBL674637".

name: chembl_get_assay

assay_type.description: Assay type code: B=binding, F=functional, A=ADMET, T=toxicity, P=physicochemical, U=unclassified. Null when absent.

assay_type_description.description: Human-readable assay type, e.g. "Binding". Null when absent.

confidence_description.description: Human-readable confidence description, e.g. "Direct single protein target assigned". Null when absent.

confidence_score.description: ChEMBL confidence score, 1–9 (9 = direct single-protein assay; lower = homologous/indirect). Null when unscored.

description.description: Assay description text. Null when absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: ChEMBL has no record for the requested identifier or structure. `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID the assay measures — chain to chembl_search_targets/chembl_get_bioactivities. Null when unassigned.

title: chembl-get-assay
